aggregates.text: THREE NOTICES STOOD UP FOR FY 2026
aggregates.subject: notices
aggregates.note: The three are enumerated inside C03's own verbatim, so the members are items within one claim rather than three claims.

aggregates.text: Three notices stood up for 2026. The Alaska-only one is not among them.
aggregates.subject: notices
aggregates.note: Same count as the kicker. The second sentence asserts an absence, and the absence is a property of the same enumeration, since C03 names exactly three and SEDS-AK is not one of them.

aggregates.text: THE SAME MONTH, TWO DIFFERENT SHAPES
aggregates.subject: different shapes
aggregates.note: The two shapes are EAGLE's 31 awards (C13) and the AI3 Action Institute's single award (C16). SAME MONTH is carried by C11 and C29, both closing 2026-08-27.
31 is printed on the listing as Expected Number of Awards and is read straight off C13, not derived. Declared because the slide also DRAWS 31 teeth, so the drawn count has to equal the printed one.

aggregates.text: EAGLE'S FIVE PROJECT AREAS, AS LISTED
aggregates.subject: project areas
items: Indigenous Designs to Empower and Advance Self-Determination
aggregates.note: Enumerated inside C09. The fifth name's expansion is C08, which is on the grants listing and not in the Federal Register, and the slide says so.

aggregates.text: THE FIVE AREAS ARE NAMED IN THE NOTICE
aggregates.subject: areas
items: Indigenous Designs to Empower and Advance Self-Determination
aggregates.note: The same five. NAMED IN THE NOTICE is the deck's argument and it is a property of C09 itself, since the listing is where the names appear.

aggregates.text: ONE COMMENTER, $3.1M OVER THREE YEARS, A 70 PERCENT CUT
aggregates.note: THREE YEARS is inside the commenter's own quoted assertion in C22, not the studio's arithmetic. The slide runs it beside C23, where ANA says the figure is 3.1 million per fiscal year, and asserts the disagreement rather than either reading.
